title: Title tag present
description: A page title helps identify the page and may be used for its search-result title link.

title: Title length
description: The 30–60 character range is an editing guide; search results may use different title text or truncate it.

title: Unique title declaration
description: Multiple title declarations can give crawlers conflicting page titles.

title: Meta description present
description: A meta description gives search and answer engines a summary to show.

title: Meta description length
description: The 70–160 character range is an editing guide; search results may choose different text or truncate it.

title: Unique meta description declaration
description: Multiple meta descriptions can give crawlers conflicting summaries.

title: Canonical URL
description: An absolute canonical link prevents duplicate-content dilution.

title: Unique canonical declaration
description: Multiple canonical links can give crawlers conflicting URL preferences.

title: Named links
description: Links with href need detectable source text, an aria-label, or image alt text.

title: Single H1
description: One H1 states the page topic for crawlers and assistive tech.

title: Mobile viewport
description: A device-width viewport tag supports responsive layout; this check does not establish mobile usability or indexing.

title: Language declared
description: The html lang attribute tells engines and screen readers the content language.

title: Image alt text
description: Alt attributes make images indexable and accessible.

title: Open Graph tags
description: og:title, og:description and og:image control how the page is shared.

title: Indexable
description: A noindex directive removes the page from search and AI answers.

title: Valid JSON-LD
description: Structured data must parse to be used for rich results and AI grounding.

title: Question headings
description: Headings phrased as questions match how people ask answer engines.

title: Author markup
description: Author and Person structured data carry E-E-A-T signals that answer engines weigh.

title: Semantic content wrapper
description: <article> or <main> lets generative engines isolate the primary content.

title: Modified date
description: AI-cited pages are fresher on average; expose a machine-readable modified date.

title: Image dimensions
description: Width and height attributes reserve space and prevent layout shift (CLS).

title: Lazy-loaded images
description: This check uses image order after the first two as a lazy-loading clue; confirm which images are actually offscreen before changing loading.

title: Render-blocking scripts
description: Scripts in <head> without defer/async delay first paint and raise TBT.
